title: eludite.browser.tab_open input
description: Open a new browser tab, make it the active tab, and, when `url` is given, navigate it and wait for the page's load event (up to 30 s). Launches the browser first when it is not running (a few hundred milliseconds to a few seconds), with the workspace's own profile under .eludite/browser/profile. Answers the tab. Next: eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.screenshot to see the page, eludite.browser.navigate to go elsewhere. A navigation error (`net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`, ...) fails the command; the tab stays open. Permission class execute; a `url` off the allowed origins (the solution policy's `browser.origins`: localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], files under the workspace and the workspace's launch urls by default) makes the call dangerous, which prompts (ADR-0009).
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when `url` is off the allowed origins (the solution policy's `browser.origins`).

url.description: An absolute URL with a scheme (`http://localhost:5000/`, `file:///...`, `about:blank`). Omitted: the tab shows about:blank.
